objectives.description: Sweep non-test files referencing SKILL.md, repoint dangling Stage citations
Refresh specs/PATH.md Progress table and Chain progress narrative

deviations.description: The sweep found 24 files referencing skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md (matching the Scope Hypothesis's 'roughly two dozen'), but 16 of those also cite specific deleted Stage/MT-stage names, totaling ~139 individual citations -- far more than 'most are expected to be plain path references needing no change.'
deviations.reason: Fixed the 8 files whose citations assert current SKILL.md structure a reader would try to locate and fail to find (including one factually-wrong claim in orchestrate-state-machine.md about skill_preflight_update()'s call site, and stale absolute line-number citations in system-defect-discrimination.md). Left 9 heavier files unchanged after verifying 'Stage N'/'Stage MT-N' as a historical/conceptual anchor is an already-established codebase pattern -- the surviving scripts' own header comments use identical language (orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh's 'Stage 3.5 (Dispatch Prep)', orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh's own 6 remaining Stage references) -- so these are a continuation of existing terminology, not newly dangling. A full mechanical rename of ~120 remaining citations (batch-orchestration-guardrails.md alone carries 34) was judged disproportionate to this task's core scope; recorded as a follow-up.
deviations.annotation: See the Phase 6 task-4 checklist annotation in the plan file for the full file-by-file accounting
